Consonantal i

Theme

Latin word

efficiō

efficiō, efficere, effēcī, effectum

verb, third conjugation (-iō): with an accusative, or ut and the subjunctive

bring about, cause; bring it about (that someone can); bring it about that; manage, bring it about (that)

In this lexicon

  • cause

    the recommended word · classical · Varr. RR 1.12.2: efficiunt difficilīs morbōs; Caes. BG 4.29.1: quī diēs maritimōs aestūs maximōs in Ōceanō efficere cōnsuēvit

  • enable

    also used · classical · Cic. Lael. 59 (Lewis & Short)

  • ensure

    also used · classical · Cic. Lael. 59 (Lewis & Short)

  • manage

    the recommended word · classical · Catull. 76.14: vērum hoc quā lubet efficiās

    certain tiny creatures breed that the eye cannot follow; they get into the body through the air, by the mouth and nose, and cause serious illnessesVarr. RR 1.12.2
